spans.s:
क्लेद, अस्, m. wetness, dampness, moisture; run-
ning, discharge from a sore.
—क्लेद-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, moist, flowing.

क्लेदक, अस्, आ, अम्, wetting, moistening, making
wet or moist; (अस्), m. phlegm in the stomach,
excess of saliva.

क्लेदन, अस्, ई, अम्, moistening, making wet;
(अस्), m. phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor
[cf. कफ]; a species of phlegm; (अम्), n. wet-
ting, moistening; oozing, trickling.

क्लेदु, उस्, m. the moon; a morbid combination
of the three humors of the body (सन्निपात), com-
plication of disorders.
क्लेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be moistened, to be wetted.

क्लेश, अस्, m. pain, affliction, distress; pain from
disease, anguish; wrath, anger; worldly occupation;
care, trouble.
—क्लेश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing pain,
afflicting.
—क्लेश-क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, capable of
enduring pain and trouble.
—क्लेश-द, अस्, आ, अम्,
distressing.
—क्लेश-नाशन, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying
or palliating trouble.
—क्लेश-प्रहाण, अम्, n. ter-
mination of distress, especially of worldly cares and
[]
passions.
—क्लेश-भागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having trouble.
—क्लेश-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, having trouble.
—क्लेशा-
पह (˚श-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, allaying pain or suffer-
ing, consolatory, consoling; palliative; (अस्), m. a son.
क्लेश क्लेश. See under rt. क्लिश्.

क्लेशक, अस्, ई, अम्, giving pain, troublesome,
annoying, afflicting.
क्लेशित, अस्, आ, अम्, pained, distressed, afflicted.

क्लेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, connected with pain, causing pain
or suffering; hurting, injuring.
क्लेष्टृ, टा, m. one who causes pain or suffering.

क्लेश् क्लेश्, cl. 1. A. क्लेशते, चिक्लेशे, क्लेशि-
तुम्, to speak articulately; to impede or
obstruct; to strike, kill; to distress.
